The role

As an Associate Director, Corporate Strategy & Development, you will be a senior member of a small, AI enabled team of highly driven and committed individuals, reporting to the Director Corporate Strategy & Development. This role balances corporate development / M&A with corporate strategy. You lead projects across both areas as the day-to-day owner and guide a small number of more junior colleagues and internal functional experts. You operate with minimal direction and take projects from a vague problem statement to a CEO-ready recommendation. You also stay hands-on, personally building the models and analysis and preparing the executive-level outputs that drive investment and strategy decisions.

What you’ll do

jobs.title: Associate Director, Global Customer Experience & Compensation Strategy
jobs.address: Berlin, Tauentzienstraße, City West, Charlottenburg, Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf, Berlin, 10789, Deutschland
jobs.description:
About the Role 

Within Global Customer Experience (GCX), our mission is to advance the HelloFresh customer relationship from reactive resolution to proactive, trust-building service. The compensation function sits at the heart of that mission: it is the mechanism through which the business acknowledges failures, restores customer confidence, and, when done well, turns a bad experience into a reason to stay.

The Associate Director, Customer Compensation & Policy is responsible for the global strategy, architecture, and governance of how HelloFresh compensates customers across all markets and brands. This is not a policy maintenance role. It is a strategic function that sits at the intersection of customer economics, operational data, behavioral experimentation, and cross-functional influence.

You will own one of the most financially material and customer-sensitive levers in the business. You will shape a multi-year roadmap and hold peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market Leadership accountable for the quality of inputs that determine how well and how efficiently we recover customer trust.

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination: analytical rigor sharp enough to architect a global compensation engine from first principles, and the executive presence to drive adoption across a complex, multi-market organization without formal authority over most of the people they need to move.

What You'll Own 

 Global Compensation Strategy & Engine Architecture

  • Own the end-to-end strategic vision for how HelloFresh categorizes customer errors and determines compensation across all markets, brands, and contact channels.
  • Lead the design and continuous evolution of the compensation engine: along with Tech, you’ll define the the rules, thresholds, segmentation logic, and automation frameworks that govern recovery decisions at scale.
  • Define the principles that govern trade-offs between customer generosity and cost discipline and translate those principles into operational rules that hold across market complexity and brand variation.
  • Partner with Technology to ensure the compensation engine is scalable, auditable, and capable of supporting dynamic, AI-assisted decisioning as the product evolves.

Experimentation & Behavioral Economics

  • Set the global roadmap for compensation experimentation: A/B testing across offer types, value levels, channel timing, and segmentation variables.
  • Apply behavioral economics frameworks to compensation design understanding how recovery offers shape long-term retention, repurchase behavior, and brand perception, not just immediate satisfaction.
  • Define the measurement framework for experimentation: what constitutes a successful test, what confidence warrants global rollout, and how results are synthesized into durable policy change.
  • Partner with Analytics & Insights to ensure test design, sample integrity, and rollout analysis meet a rigorous standard of evidence.

Financial Stewardship & Cost Governance

  • Own the global compensation P&L line: tracking spend by market, error category, customer segment, and channel — and holding yourself accountable to defined cost-per-incident and avoidable-contact targets.
  • Identify and close financial leakage: cases where compensation is being issued without policy justification, at incorrect values, or at the wrong frequency.
  • Build the reporting infrastructure that makes compensation economics visible to GCX leadership, market GMs, and Finance — with the granularity and context needed to drive decisions.
  • Define the right balance between cost optimization and customer lifetime value investment: not just 'spend less' but 'spend where it earns back.

Fraud Policy & Global Governance

  • Own the global fraud and abuse prevention framework: the policies, detection logic, thresholds, and escalation paths that protect the business without creating friction for genuine customers.
  • Lead the governance rhythm for policy: quarterly reviews, market exception management, escalation adjudication, and framework versioning across a multi-brand, multi-market environment.
  • Act as the final authority on complex, cross-market policy gaps — resolving ambiguity with speed, consistency, and strategic clarity rather than routing decisions upward by default.
  • Maintain global standards while creating principled space for market-level adaptation where local context genuinely requires it.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Accountability

  • Represent the compensation function in senior forums translating customer economics into requirements that peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market GMs must respond to.
  • Hold cross-functional partners accountable for the upstream data quality, operational accuracy, and system reliability that the compensation engine depends on.
  • Drive adoption of policy changes across markets and brands, building communication and change management plans that make new frameworks land — not just launch.
  • Influence at VP and Director level across multiple functions; escalate only strategic blockers, not routine alignment.

What You'll Bring 

Education

  • MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification required.
  • Undergraduate degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline.

Experience

  • 8–12 years of progressive experience in customer strategy, pricing, operations, or a directly adjacent domain with meaningful exposure to global, multi-market environments.
  • Demonstrated track record of owning a financially significant operational lever and managing it with both analytical precision and strategic judgment.
  • Prior experience leading and developing teams; comfort operating as a senior individual contributor and a people leader simultaneously.
  • Background in subscription commerce, logistics, or consumer-facing operations strongly preferred. Familiarity with the economics of customer recovery in high-volume, low-margin environments is a distinct adva

About the role: What's in the Box

The Logistics Tribe builds the systems powering end-to-end delivery across North America, Europe and Australia/New Zealand: getting fresh ingredients into our facilities, giving customers the best delivery options the network can support, and tracking every box to the customer's door. Today it is a single engineering team - two staff engineers, a data engineer and seven mid-to-senior engineers - led by the Director of Engineering, owning that software and keeping it running in production. You will join as an Engineering Manager and take line management of the seven.

The work is operations-heavy and business-critical, spread across different subdomains. You won't own a fixed backlog in one corner of the domain; the team's scope follows where the business pressure is. That is reflected in how we work: rather than one fixed squad, the team organises into small, project-focused pods that form and dissolve as projects start and finish. In a typical sprint, your engineers might be spread across three projects with three different product managers.

Strategy and technical direction are things we shape together - staff engineers, product managers and you all contributing, nobody working from a script handed down. You own the people and the delivery of your engineers.

The role reports to the Director of Engineering for Logistics Tech; your team is spread across two geographies.

  • Keep raising the team's AI bar: role-model it in your own work, and push the workflows where AI genuinely changes how fast we deliver.
  • Make our project-based way of working work for people. Head of Photo Production (All genders)

Berlin

About HelloFresh

At HelloFresh, we want to change the way people eat forever by offering high-quality food and recipes to customers across 18 countries and three continents. We are the world's leading meal kit company and a global food solutions group, home to HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chef's Plate, Factor, Good Chop, The Pets Table and Youfoodz. Through technology, data and culinary innovation, we deliver personalised food experiences to millions of households worldwide.

The Role

As Head of Photo Production, you will lead our Berlin photo production team, setting the strategic direction, operational standards and ways of working for a high-volume, multi-brand studio. Combining commercial photography expertise, excellent people leadership and strong systems capabilities, you will deliver marketing, lifestyle and product content for HelloFresh, Factor and our international markets.

You will establish scalable production standards across markets and help shape our transition towards modular content and AI-assisted workflows. Working closely with the Lead Photographer, Lead Art Director, Head of AI, Head of Studio Operations and regional content leaders, you will align creative quality, team development and efficient delivery.

This role covers photo production. Video and XPod are outside its scope.

What You'll Do

People Leadership

  • Lead and develop the Berlin photo production team, including the Lead Photographer, coaching experienced specialists and senior team members.
  • Set clear expectations and development plans, provide regular feedback, and build a collaborative, accountable team culture.
  • Lead hiring and establish effective onboarding for team members, freelancers and agency partners.

Systems & Operational Excellence

  • Own the photo production workflow from briefing and capture through file management, tagging and handover to Post-Production.
  • Drive adoption of studio production systems, digital asset management (DAM) platforms and SaaS-based workflow tools, partnering with Studio Operations on the new asset management setup.
  • Standardise briefs, templates and metadata across markets, reducing avoidable handoffs and rework and measuring improvements in efficiency, quality and cost.

Quality & International Standards

  • Establish a consistent review and feedback process with the Lead Photographer and Lead Art Director, covering lighting, styling, composition, retouching and brand consistency.
  • Partner with regional content leaders, including the Head of Content, North America, to strengthen studio capabilities and align production with global standards.

Photography, AI & Innovation

  • Partner with the Head of AI to develop hybrid production workflows, assessing their impact on quality, roles, cost and capacity with the Head of Studio Operations.
  • Build the team’s capabilities as tools evolve, test new photography techniques and share successful approaches with creative and brand teams.
  • Develop modular content that allows individual shoots to serve multiple brands, markets and formats.

Planning & Delivery

  • Partner closely with the Head of Studio Operations on photo production capacity, schedules, budgets and reshoots.
  • Be accountable for quality and on-time delivery, managing production resources and escalating risks early with recommended solutions.

This role owns the upstream half of that workflow: turning brand strategy, performance data, and channel diversity needs into a steady, distinctive pipeline of concepts for TikTok and emerging platforms like Pinterest and Snap.   • Concept development and briefing: Translate the brand foundation, persona blueprint, and cohort-level performance data into briefs for TikTok-first video, UGC, Spark Ads, and creator partnerships. Push the team away from "repurposed Reels" toward native TikTok concepts. Develop distinct concepts monthly for local markets with a structured cadence of net new ideation vs iterations.

jobs.title: TikTok & New Growth Channels Creative Strategist (all genders)

jobs.description:
The role

We're rebuilding HelloFresh's paid social engine around the reality that creative is the single largest performance lever on TikTok. TikTok's algorithm rewards platform-native concepts and the brands winning today treat the brief, the editor, and the ad account as one continuous workflow.

This role owns the upstream half of that workflow: turning brand strategy, performance data, and channel diversity needs into a steady, distinctive pipeline of concepts for TikTok and emerging platforms like Pinterest and Snap. You don't run media - you make sure the media team always has the most testable, on-brand, platform-native ideas in the queue and that what works keeps getting iterated on

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

  • Concept development and briefing: Translate the brand foundation, persona blueprint, and cohort-level performance data into briefs for TikTok-first video, UGC, Spark Ads, and creator partnerships. Push the team away from "repurposed Reels" toward native TikTok concepts. Develop distinct concepts monthly for local markets with a structured cadence of net new ideation vs iterations.
  • Creative pipeline orchestration: Own the brief from concept to source: determining the right direction and matching it to the right production partner (internal studio, influencer, agency partners, TikTok Creative Exchange) based on the needs of the account. Work closely with creative operations to ensure briefs are executed on time and volume targets are met without sacrificing creative diversity or fatigue-window speed.
  • Hands-on collaboration with editors and producers: Be integrated in the creative process and come with a strong point of view on assets: push back on first drafts, defend hooks, kill weak openers, and own the final execution of an asset. You know what a winning TikTok hook looks like and why it's different from a Reels hook — before it goes live, and can articulate why.
  • Performance-to-brief feedback loop: Mine ad-level data (CTR, hook rate, hold rate, CVR by cohort) to identify what's working and what to retire. Close the loop weekly so the next sprint's briefs are grounded in evidence, not opinion.
  • Format and source diversification: Drive the shift toward video-first, UGC-style, and Spark Ads with creator-led content on TikTok. Build platform-fit creative strategy for Pinterest and Snap pilots as they scale, adapting concepts to each platform rather than porting Meta assets over.
  • Future-channel creative scouting: Stay ahead on what's next - Reddit, emerging short-video platforms — and maintain a point of view on what creative approach earns a pilot slot.
  • Brand coherence at speed: Keep creatives on-strategy across multiple markets while preserving the velocity TikTok and new platforms demand.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years in paid social creative strategy at a high-spend D2C, subscription, or performance-led brand. Direct experience briefing and reviewing UGC, creator content, and short-form video is non-negotiable.
  • Deep hands-on TikTok creative fluency — you understand Spark Ads, TikTok Creative Exchange, and the creative fatigue window that makes speed non-negotiable. Working knowledge of Pinterest and Snap creative formats is a plus.
  • Strong creative instinct paired with comfort reading performance data — you can defend a concept and kill it when the numbers say so.
  • Track record of working hands-on with editors, producers, and creators — not just managing decks. Familiarity with Motion, Smartly, or similar creative analytics is a plus.
  • Sharp understanding of how TikTok's algorithm rewards native creative and creative diversity, and how that translates into briefing strategy.
  • Comfortable steering peers across Brand, Influencer, and external partners without direct authority.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.address: Barcelona, 67, Müllerstraße, Afrikanisches Viertel, Wedding, Mitte, Berlin, 13349, Deutschland
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

We're looking for a Product Designer to join N26's UX team in our Grow and Engage domain. There are a couple of areas within the domain where we're adding design strength, and we'll match you to the right one based on your background and what you're drawn to.

In this role, you'll work in the Grow & Engage domain—the heart of the customer experience ranging from the acquisition and signup to our premium membership tiers and the daily engagement of our users. You will work in teams delivering the newest and most innovative features serving our customers in the best way possible. You'll design end-to-end on important features and flows that millions of customers use every day. You'll report to our Head of UX, and work in a tight cross-functional team of product, engineering, research, and data partners. We'll back you to grow your craft on work that matters—to customers, to the business, and to your own development as a designer.

We believe our team's diversity is our strength. The more perspectives at the table, the better. Please apply regardless of your identity, experience, or background.

Please note: 

  • We highly encourage you to attach your most recent portfolio and CV in English to your application. 
  • Applications without a portfolio will not be considered

About the Work

The Grow and Engage domain is where we shape how customers get genuine, lasting value from N26. It covers a broad slice of the core product—the moments that bring customers back to their day-to-day banking, the features that build habits and surface real value, and the way our paid tiers turn into something subscribers actively feel.

The work spans the home screen, in-app discovery, recommendations and AI-powered insights, the cross-cutting patterns that pull the whole product together, and our Smart, Go, and Metal subscription tiers—where the opportunity is to weave value through the product rather than bolt it on. You'll have meaningful scope to shape both how we package what we have today and what comes next.

You'll be designing for a fintech product used by millions, in a category where customers' expectations have been shaped by some of the best digital products in the world. The bar is high, and the work matters.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Design end-to-end on important features within your segment, from problem framing through research, exploration, and shipped work.
  • Bring a high bar for craft—UI and interaction design that delights customers and converts.
  • Frame design problems sharply: define user needs, success criteria, constraints, and tradeoffs before jumping into solutions.
  • Develop user flows and interactions that hold up across the connected parts of the product, anticipating how your work affects adjacent areas.
  • Contribute to our design system—using and improving the patterns the team relies on.
  • Be data-informed: plan and run research that blends qualitative and quantitative methods, and proactively seek out the data you need when it isn't on the table.
  • Partner closely with product, engineering, research, and data to ship work that actually lands—and to take it further once it's live.

jobs.description: What does it mean to be a Consultant at Netlight? As Netlight consultants, we work in business-critical projects at the forefront of digitalisation, with the mission of unleashing the full potential in our clients and ourselves. You will be a part of shaping the software products and technical solutions of today and tomorrow alongside your colleagues and clients. Instead of predefined roles, we tailor positions to fit individuals. You will have a Mentor, Coach, EDGE networks, and social communities to accelerate your personal and professional growth. The possibilities are endless. Our focus is not just on the digital product, we engage and make an impact on the team and the business. jobs.description: Do you want to be a part of co-creating and shaping the Vienna expansion and growth, of one of the most successful Tech consultancies in Europe? jobs.description: Join our Commercial & Sales Talent Community At Shiftmove , we’re building the next generation of connected mobility products that help businesses across Europe make smarter, data-driven decisions. Als erste Anlaufstelle für Kund innen, Kolleg innen und Partner bist du im Service die Visitenkarte unseres Unternehmens. Wir glauben daran, dass echter Service mehr ist als Abläufe und Prozesse: Es geht um Menschen, um Aufmerksamkeit und um das gute Gefühl, bestens betreut zu sein. Deine Mission bei uns: Du bist Organisationstalent, Möglichmacher in und Stimmungsträger in in einem. Du denkst mit, handelst proaktiv und behältst auch in stressigen Momenten den Überblick. Für dich bedeutet guter Service nicht nur „reagieren“, sondern aktiv gestalten – mit einem Lächeln, klarer Kommunikation und einem sicheren Gespür für das, was wirklich gebraucht wird. An insgesamt 25 Standorten sind wir mit den Marken Opel, Ford, Kia, Suzuki sowie den Premium Marken Land Rover und Jaguar in mehreren Bundesländern vertreten. Als modernes, zukunftsorientiertes Unternehmen setzen wir auf engagierte Menschen, die mitdenken, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen wollen. Terminvergabe und -koordination für Werkstatt- und Servicetermine. Anlage und Pflege von Kunden- und Fahrzeugdaten im System. Unterstützung des Service-Teams bei der täglichen Organisation und Kommunikation. Erstellung von Werkstattaufträgen und Rechnungen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Serviceberater. Vor- und Nachbereitung von Kundenterminen , inkl. Unterlagen, Fahrzeugschlüssel, Leihwagen etc. Koordination und Verwaltung von Mietfahrzeugen am Standort. Kassenführung und Abrechnung. Bearbeitung des Post- und E-Mail-Verkehrs im Servicebereich. Mitwirkung bei Aktionen und Kampagnen , z. B. saisonale Serviceangebote. Sicherstellung eines professionellen und aufgeräumten Empfangsbereichs . Das bringst du mit: Du hast eine kaufmännische Ausbildung oder Berufserfahrung im Empfangs-, Service- oder Kundenbereich. Du bist ein Organisationstalent und besitzt ein gutes Gespür für Menschen und Situationen. Ob am Telefon, persönlich oder schriftlich beweist du Kommunikationsstärke und setzt diese gewinnbringend ein. Remote Flexibilität – 100 % Homeoffice aus Deutschland, keine Mikromanagement‑Kultur. Karriere‑Boost – schnelle Aufstiegschancen in einer wachsenden Unit. Attraktives Gehalt – €50‑70 k Jahresgehalt plus Benefits. Innovatives Tech‑Stack – Arbeit mit einer KI‑basierten Sustainability‑Plattform. Deine Aufgaben Aufbau und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des PCF/LCA‑Kundenprozesses. End‑to‑End‑Betreuung von Kundenprojekten: Datenaufnahme, Modellierung, Validierung und Ergebnispräsentation. jobs.description: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register . We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. Staff Platform Engineer, Agentic Engineering Developer Productivity · AI Coding Agents · Developer Platform Our ambition: an engineering organisation where humans and agents work as one continuously learning system, turning frontier AI capabilities and real-world feedback into more ambitious product development. We want n8n to be the reference for how this is done, without compromising quality, resilience or trust. Your main goal is to make that real. This is a Staff individual contributor role in Developer Platform and the technical driving force behind ACDC (Agent-centric Development Cycle), our engineering-wide initiative for agentic development. Nobody has a playbook for this yet. You'll write ours. You won't start from zero. Agents wired into Linear already automate around 80% of the development cycle on one of our developer platform projects, alongside pilots for insight, feature-flag and PR-review agents and a shared agent harness. Your job is to take this from promising experiments to the way n8n builds software. This role is for someone who thinks about this problem constantly. You run agents all day, rebuild your own workflow every time the frontier moves, and have more ideas than time. You'll stay hands-on, building the first versions yourself, and shape how the work grows beyond one person. What you'll do Set direction and own the outcome Identify where agentic development can make the greatest difference, using developer feedback, existing experiments and engineering performance data. Set the strategy and priorities across agent execution, repository readiness, CI, security and developer workflows. Make build, buy or pass decisions on tools and vendors, and own the cost and value trade-offs, including AI spend. Make decisions where requirements are incomplete and the trade-offs between autonomy, reliability, security and review effort are still emerging. Build alignment through technical proposals, clear decisions and working software, and report progress and impact to engineering leadership. Build the foundations Design and build isolated execution environments where agents can work with the right access to code, tools and context, without exposing secrets or sensitive systems. Own the safety model: which task categories agents may attempt, what they must never touch, and where human review is required, partnering with Security on sensitive areas like auth, billing, permissions and data handling. Make n8n's monorepo agent-ready, working with Architecture and senior engineers on repo structure, testability, boundaries and the context agents need. Integrate agents into how we work Build repeatable workflows that take Linear issues through agent execution, self-verification and review to merged PRs, across a growing range of task types. Integrate agentic workflows with GitHub, CI, test infrastructure and code review, so the agentic path becomes the easiest path for engineers. Extend the loop beyond coding: connect earlier signals like product research and customer requests, and later ones like production metrics, so agents contribute across the whole cycle. Open it up beyond engineering, so PMs, designers and others can turn a well-defined issue into a reviewed, mergeable change. Shape review practices, such as PR evidence that shows what changed, what ran, what risks remain and where human judgment is needed. Measure what works Build benchmarks from real historical engineering tasks to evaluate output quality, failure modes, review burden and production risk. Define and track quality and adoption signals, such as reviewer acceptance rate, CI pass rate, rework rate and developer satisfaction. Use data and feedback to change course, retire what doesn't work, and build trust across engineering. Requirements Must-haves 🔥 Frontier obsession: You live at the frontier. You try new models and tools as they land, and you have strong, evidence-backed opinions on what's real and what's hype. 🧭 Staff-scope ownership: You’ve led complex platform, DevEx or engineering productivity initiatives across teams, from defining the problem to sustained adoption and measurable impact, where there was no established approach to follow. 🤖 Agentic depth: You use coding agents daily as a power user, and you've built infrastructure around them, such as repo context and instructions, tool or MCP integrations, sandboxed execution or agent workflows in CI, that other engineers rely on. 🎯 Product mindset for internal platforms: You treat engineers as your customers. You start from real friction, prioritise by impact, make build-vs-buy calls, weigh cost against value, and let adoption tell you whether something works. 🤝 Direction without authority: You've set technical direction that multiple teams followed, through proposals, design reviews and credibility with senior engineers across Platform, Product Engineering, AI, Security and Architecture. 🔐 Safety judgment: You've made real decisions on permissions, secrets, sandboxing, sensitive code paths and human-in-the-loop review, and can explain the trade-offs. 📊 Measurement that drives decisions: You've built evaluations, benchmarks or quality metrics and used them to change course or retire things that didn't

jobs.description: At flaconi, we believe that diversity fuels creativity, innovation and growth. It thrives in all its forms of beauty. Our team is a mosaic of individuals from different backgrounds, cultures and life journeys, all united by a shared passion for beauty. Our commitment is grounded in our core values, particularly #trustinpeople . We hold ourselves accountable for creating an environment where every employee feels honestly valued, heard and empowered to contribute their unique perspectives to foster belonging. flaconi is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes and encourages all qualified from all backgrounds and identities, regardless of ethnicity, race, gender identity, migration background, national origin, disability status, sexual orientation, religion, or age to apply. We will do our best to make this possible. We are seeking a (Senior) Data Scientist (all genders) to join a dynamic team of five within our DATA department. You'll dive into diverse challenges including training and deploying machine learning models, developing Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, and statistical modeling. We believe in flat hierarchies, which means you'll work closely with colleagues of various seniorities in a fun environment. You'll play a key role in extracting valuable insights and developing data and AI solutions to optimize our e-commerce platform across Europe, taking end-to-end ownership of your projects and collaborating closely with business stakeholders along the way. Your contributions will have a direct impact on business decisions and process efficiency across a wide spectrum of unique use cases. Your Role Employ statistical techniques and machine learning algorithms for regression, classification, and clustering (e.g., Gradient Boosting, Random Forest, Hierarchical Clustering, ensemble methods). Develop and productionalize Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions alongside modern NLP techniques using transformer architectures (e.g., BERT, GPT). Utilize time-series forecasting methods (e.g., ARIMA, LSTM, DeepAR, Prophet) for predictive modeling. Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA), advanced feature engineering, and dimensionality reduction (PCA, t-SNE). Develop and implement deep learning models in PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras while leveraging transfer learning strategies. Showcase your skills across key e-commerce data science use cases including demand forecasting, churn and CLTV modeling, pricing, customer segmentation, recommender systems, and personalization. Handle large-scale datasets using distributed computing frameworks (Apache Spark) on a tech stack comprising Python (PySpark, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, LightGBM), SQL, Databricks (Data Lakehouse & ML platform), AWS (S3, Lambda, EC2, SageMaker, Bedrock), GitHub, and AI-augmented tools (Claude, Copilot) while collaborating directly to proactively address stakeholder business needs. Your Profile Bring a minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in developing and deploying machine learning solutions for real-world business problems. Demonstrate background exposure to e-commerce (ideal) , fintech , or fast-paced agency environments. Demonstrate hands-on experience with Databricks as a Data & AI platform (required) alongside cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. Prove hands-on experience in building, productionalizing, and deploying Generative AI or Agentic AI solutions. Apply hands-on experience with MLOps practices and tools (required) for end-to-end model lifecycle management. Possess a strong grasp of core data science principles to select the most appropriate techniques, combined with advanced proficiency in SQL, Python (PySpark, scikit-learn, NumPy, matplotlib, pandas), and AI-augmented development tools (Claude, Copilot). Communicate exceptionally in English (written and verbal) to articulate complex concepts to non-technical stakeholders, driving projects with full end-to-end ownership as a collaborative team player.
